info.title: NATS HTTP Gateway
info.description:
This is the API for interacting with NATS and NATS
based services using HTTP.

get.summary: Retrieves a value from the key value store.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: the value of the key at the specified revision. Note the revision may not be available.

X-Nats-Kv-Bucket.description: the name of the bucket (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Created.description: date when the entry was created (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Revision.description: the revision storing the entry (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Delta.description: number of revisions from current the KV is on (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Operation.description: the operation (PUT, DEL, PURGE) represented by the entry (only on application/text)

200.description: success response body is payload, and metadata is HTTP headers. On JSON responses the value property is base64 encoded.

post.summary: Adds a new entry to the key value store, fails if the entry exists.

X-Nats-Kv-Sequence.description: the sequence assigned to the entry (only on application/text)

put.summary: Adds or updates an existing entry at an optional revision

parameters.name: previousRevision
parameters.description: the expected previous revision. If specified and the key is not at the specified revision the operation fails.

X-Nats-Kv-Sequence.description: the sequence assigned to the entry (only on application/text)

409.description: Key already exists if previousRevision is incorrect

get.summary: Returns metadata on the key value store

X-Nats-Kv-Name.description: the name of the bucket (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Values.description: the number of entries in the KV - includes history (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-History.description: the number of possible history per key (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Ttl.description: the amount of time entries live in the bucket (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Backing-Store.description: the backing store for the KV (memory or disk) (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Size.description: the size of the bucket in bytes (only on application/text)

X-Nats-Kv-Compression.description: true if the KV is compressed (only on application/text)

parameters.name: X-Nats-Kv-Max-Value-Size
parameters.description: the maximum size for an entry (only on application/text)

parameters.name: X-Nats-Kv-History
parameters.description: the number of possible history per key (only on application/text)

parameters.name: X-Nats-Kv-Ttl
parameters.description: the amount of time entries live in the bucket in nanoseconds (only on application/text)

parameters.name: X-Nats-Kv-Max-Bytes
parameters.description: the maximum size of the KV in bytes (only on application/text)

parameters.name: X-Nats-Kv-Storage
parameters.description: the underlying storage for the KV (only on application/text)

parameters.name: X-Nats-Kv-Replicas
parameters.description: the underlying number of replicas (only on application/text)

parameters.name: X-Nats-Kv-Compression
parameters.description: compress the KV store (only on application/text)

parameters.name: metaOnly
parameters.description: if true, only the metadata of the object is returned, the body will not contain any data

X-Nats-Obj-Nuid.description: the identifier that used to store the entry's data

X-Nats-Obj-Size.description: the size of the entry's data in bytes

X-Nats-Obj-Mod-Time.description: date when the entry was last modified

X-Nats-Obj-Chunks.description: the number of chunks used to store the entry

X-Nats-Obj-Digest.description: the Base64 encoded SHA-256 digest of the entry's data

X-Nats-Obj-Max-Chunk-Size.description: the maximum size in bytes of a single chunk

X-Nats-Obj-Link-Bucket.description: if set, the name of the bucket containing the entry

X-Nats-Obj-Link-Name.description: if set, the name of the entry as stored in a different bucket

X-Nats-Obj-Deleted.description: if true, the entry is marked as deleted

get.summary: Returns metadata on the object store

schema.description: the backing store type - only set for application/text requests
the name of the bucket - only set for application/text requests
the ttl for entries in the bucket in nanoseconds (0 doesn't expire) - only set for application/text requests
the number of replicas for the bucket - only set for application/text requests
the size of the bucket in bytes - only set for application/text requests
the metadata for the bucket, all keys in metadata are prefixed by `X-Nats-Obj-Meta-` - only set for application/text requests

parameters.name: timeout

parameters.name: NatsH-*
parameters.description: Header prefix - any HTTP request with a header that has the `NatsH-` prefix will have the prefix dropped, and have the header included on the published message.
